explanation: f(n) counts the sum-free subsets of [1,n] (IsSumFree, i.e. no a = b + c with a, b, c ∈ A), as on erdosproblems.com/748. Green and Sapozhenko proved f(n) ≪ 2^{n/2}. The statement gives one C with f(n) ≤ C·2^{n/2} for all n, which is equivalent since finitely many small n are absorbed into C. Faithful.
